'''2022 MPC Top 8 Justin Miyashiro DS BHBM''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Miyashiro]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Miyashiro]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open BHBM Miyashiro DS 2022 MPC 2.txt |Download]]
